unauthorized.title: Access Denied
unauthorized.message: Your account does not have administrator privileges required to access this workspace.

overview.title: Good evening, Lyreo team.
overview.lead: Build English learning content without hiding infrastructure behind magic. Every long workflow is inspectable, retryable and cancellable.

jobs.title: Background Jobs
jobs.lead: PostgreSQL is the durable source of truth. R2 JSON is an artifact, never workflow state.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this background job?
cancelDialog.description: Cancellation is cooperative. The worker will stop at a safe checkpoint and preserve durable job state.

aiSettings.title: Provider routing
aiSettings.lead: Provider/model is runtime data. Product prompts stay in Java business modules; plaintext provider API keys are never returned to the browser.
aiSettings.modelNamesNote: Model names remain strings by design because provider model catalogs change frequently.

fields.apiKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep existing secret

aiSettings.encryptionNote: The master encryption key stays outside the database. Provider secrets are AES-GCM encrypted at rest.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
curriculum.text: Build learning paths from references to Lesson, Grammar, TOEIC and future content types.

lexicon.title: Lexicon
lexicon.text: Global dictionary with provenance, missing-Vietnamese maintenance and lazy enrichment.

placeholders.boundary: This boundary is intentional; full domain-specific CRUD belongs to a later implementation slice rather than a fake starter screen.

lessonAuthoring.title: Create a YouTube lesson
lessonAuthoring.lead: Choose a segment, approve its transcript and timing, then review learning content before publication.
lessonAuthoring.overlap: This segment overlaps an existing lesson. You may continue.
lessonAuthoring.rights: I confirm I have the appropriate rights to acquire and process this media.
lessonAuthoring.embedBlocked: This video cannot be embedded. Choose another source.
lessonAuthoring.invalidRange: Enter a title, a valid segment within the video, and confirm media rights.
lessonAuthoring.published: Published. Content and selected activities are locked.
lessonAuthoring.preparing: The transcript is not ready yet. Job details above show preparation progress or errors.
lessonAuthoring.playerError: YouTube playback is unavailable. Check embedding permissions and your connection before approving timing.
lessonAuthoring.playerNote: Click a sentence to seek. Playback stays within the selected segment and skips excluded sentences.
lessonAuthoring.reviewTiming: Check the complete segment against the audio. Grouped ASR timing needs manual review and may need dedicated alignment.
lessonAuthoring.karaokeConfirmed: I played and checked this revision: text, karaoke timing and excluded ranges match the audio.
lessonAuthoring.transcriptNote: Save before approval. Split at the text cursor; merge adjacent sentences with the same usage. Lexical edits require new timing.
lessonAuthoring.splitCaret: Place the text cursor between two nonempty parts before splitting.
lessonAuthoring.unsaved: Unsaved changes. Approval and generation are paused until you save.
lessonAuthoring.generationGate: Approve the saved transcript and confirm karaoke review before generation.
lessonAuthoring.contentReviewed: I reviewed the translations, annotations and selected activity sentences for publication.
lessonAuthoring.conflict: The lesson changed or is locked. Keep your edits, then reload the latest revision before retrying.

labels.SHORT_SENTENCE: Very short sentence: check its context
labels.TIMING_ZERO_DURATION: A timing interval has no duration
labels.GROUPED_TIMING: Timing covers a group of words; check karaoke against the audio
